abstract: The AI Scientist is an infinite program team: scientists, engineers, bioinformaticians, regulatory affairs, and program managers working around the clock. It wires together the digital and physical worlds of R&D. Predictive models, data infrastructure, and wet lab execution all feed a single compounding loop: design an experiment, run it, and learn.

metadata.author: Sajith Wickramasekara
